result.reason: The redline appropriately retains 12-month renewals and adds a 30-day non-renewal notice requirement, satisfying that aspect of both the preferred and fallback positions. However, it does not include the preferred 60-day Vendor reminder or any cap on renewal price increases. Because even the fallback requires price increases to be capped at 5%, the operative language does not fully reach the playbook position. The change is otherwise narrow and professionally drafted, although the margin comment omits the unaddressed pricing requirement.
